No. 1952/43 – FRIDAY, FEBRUARY 05, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460) AS THE AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION

(AMENDMENT) ACT No. 28 OF 1964 Notice under Section 7 Ref No.: ෙකʣȝාෙɢ/ඉ/අƮ/3/72/ɓƌඒ. I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands/servitudes which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the Lands/servitudes to be acquired: One Hundred and Eighty Four (184) allotments of land in extent of 0.4137 Hectare depicted as Lot Nos. 1-184 in PP Co. 9394 dated 06.01.2014 prepared by Surveyor General situated in the village of Slave Island (Ward No. 25 Slave Island in the Municipal Council limits of Colombo) within Divisional Secretary’s Division of Colombo in the District of Colombo, Western Province.
